trials.claim: Lifetime access to Easy Text Marketing Platform with 60-day code redemption window
trials.claimQuote:
Lifetime access to Easy Text Marketing Platform
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
trials.reasoning: Buyers report receiving no access after purchase and that the platform is not working or accessible, which materially undercuts the promised lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: I purchased the product yesterday! No access untill now!!!
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports receiving no access after purchase, undermining the lifetime access promise.

exhibits.quote: The platform isn't working as expected, and the tutorial page hasn't been accessible for a long time.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports the platform is not working and inaccessible, undermining usable lifetime access.

trials.claim: Unlimited messaging and voice broadcasts with gateway connected
trials.claimQuote:
Unlimited messaging (with your gateway connected)
- Unlimited voice broadcasts (with your gateway connected)
trials.reasoning: Buyers report they could not use any gateway or send messages and that the gateway is missing, directly conflicting with unlimited messaging and voice broadcasts with a gateway connected.

exhibits.quote: I couldn't use any gateway, I couldn't send any messages, I couldn't even upload a single contact.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports inability to use any gateway or send messages, contradicting unlimited messaging with gateway connected.

exhibits.quote: this product doesn't work as advertised the gateway is missing the agency section is missing as well.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports the gateway is missing, undermining messaging and voice broadcasts with gateway connected.

trials.claim: Unlimited groups, keywords, digital coupons, and mobile kiosks & contests
trials.claimQuote:
- Unlimited groups
- Unlimited keywords
- Unlimited digital coupons
- Unlimited mobile kiosks & contests
trials.reasoning: A buyer reports the key advertised features are not available, materially undercutting the unlimited features claim despite one review saying keywords work.

exhibits.quote: I purchased this product for those key features but they are not available.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports key advertised features are not available, undermining unlimited groups, keywords and related features.

exhibits.quote: I am using this for a real estate brokerage. I use the MLS number as the keyword, and it works perfectly!
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms the keywords feature works perfectly in real use.

trials.claim: Up to 50 team member accounts included sharing gateway
trials.claimQuote: Up to 50 team member accounts included (sharing your gateway)
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were provided about team member accounts, so the claim cannot be checked either way.

Email to SMS replies
- 25 Resellable Client Account Licenses
trials.reasoning: The review only says reselling would be hard because of the interface and setup; it does not say the 25 resellable licenses were missing or not included.

exhibits.quote: the idea was to resell to my clients which is going to be hard based on the non-friendly user interface and the difficult setup.
exhibits.argument: Buyer who bought to resell reports reselling is hard due to interface and setup, undermining resellable licenses value.

exhibits.quote: Mat and his support team listens to the users and incorporates the features to make it even better.
